capabilities: Encrypt fenced lockblock code blocks with a random vault key protected by a password
Reveal, hide, or copy plaintext from sealed blocks in reading view without writing it back to the note
Block edits to sealed ciphertext while the vault is locked
Sync the wrapped keyring across devices via plugin settings
Issue a recovery key for regaining access to sealed blocks
disambiguation: Not a full-vault encryption tool; it encrypts only fenced lockblock code blocks inside individual notes.
extras: README warns to back up the vault first because encryption or sync errors can make sealed content unrecoverable. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer for app.secretStorage. Full command list lives in docs/commands.md, not the README.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain text files, so sensitive sections are readable in the raw file even when you do not want them visible.
summary: Note-encryption plugin that seals fenced lockblock code blocks with a vault key and shows them as locked cards until you unlock with a password.
